notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Soldiers.
description:
Cast Recruit the Worthy with buyback by paying {3}{W}, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token and returning Recruit the Worthy to your hand.
When the Soldier enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Soldier you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Soldier, adding {W}.
Repeat.
If you control four or more other Soldiers, this combo will net infinite colorless mana.
